purpose: Supplemental natural-main graph operator coverage only; not part of R24 fixed-20 headline metrics.

selection_features: supplied context labels, units and periods
existing graph canonical names, registered aliases and source formula dependencies
selection_policy.selection_method: Read-only question keyword scan of natural data/main FinQA and TAT-QA, then inspect only Q/D/source metadata and graph structure. No prediction logs or answer values were consulted in selecting these records.
selection_policy.new_formula_priority_note: No unambiguous natural question directly matching a newly added target with fully explicit operands was found in the focused scan. A ROA question can exercise a newly added average-assets dependency, but retained equivalent paths and denominator ambiguity are disclosed rather than forced.

selected.question: what is the net income margin in the q3 of 2014?
selected.record_copy_policy: Exact original JSON line; every original field retained unchanged. Answer fields were not used as selection features.
selected.selection_reason: Natural question explicitly asks net income margin for Q3 2014. D contains same-column Net earnings (loss) and Sales and service revenues in the 2014 table; it does not directly report a margin ratio. The graph uniquely resolves the registered alias Net Income Margin to the derived Net Profit Margin node.
context_evidence: | ($ in millions, except per share amounts) | 1st Qtr | 2nd Qtr | 3rd Qtr | 4th Qtr<sup>(3)</sup> |

expected_target.resolution: Unique registered alias; no derived-first override.

expected_paths.source_formula: Net Profit Margin = Net Income ÷ Revenue
Net Profit Margin = Net Profit ÷ Sales Revenue

selected.expected_operand_alignment: Use only Q3 2014 net earnings and sales/service revenues; same currency and scale. Net Income has registered Net Earnings alias. Revenue/Sales Revenue linkage to the table label must be explicitly grounded by OES.
selected.expected_operator_coverage: Direct OES on named margin should not find an explicit ratio; OMD can expand a retained source formula, OES should bind primitive values, OPE.metric should execute, Verify may compare compatible redundant paths. This is a coverage expectation, not an observed result.
selected.new_formula_coverage: Selected for clear retained-graph coverage; no claim that an added formula will be used.
limits: Ratio and percentage variants require unit normalization before Verify.
Same-input scaled variants are not independent financial evidence.

selected.question: What is the company’s return on assets in 2017?
selected.record_copy_policy: Exact original JSON line; every original field retained unchanged. Answer fields were not used as selection features.
selected.selection_reason: Natural question explicitly asks 2017 return on assets. D includes annual Net income and Total assets for 2017 and 2016, but no reported ROA. Canonical Return on Assets is derived and contains source-supported direct and average-assets paths. This is the clearest natural candidate found with a possible newly added Average Total Assets dependency, without using an answer or prior success/failure.

expected_target.resolution: Exact canonical name; no alias-priority changes.

expected_paths.source_formula: Return on Assets = Net Profit ÷ Total Assets
Return on Assets = Net Profit / Average Total Assets

operands.metric: Total Assets at Beginning of Period

expected_paths.source_formula: Average Total Assets = (Total Assets at Beginning of Period + Total Assets at End of Period) ÷ 2

selected.expected_operand_alignment: 2017 Net Income and 2017 Total Assets are explicitly tabulated. A beginning/end average-assets path additionally needs explicit temporal binding of 2017 opening assets to the 2016 closing balance and 2017 closing assets to the 2017 balance; no unsupported period substitution is allowed.
selected.expected_operator_coverage: OMD should expose graph formulas for the named ROA. Depending on supported denominator constraints, OPE.metric may compute a direct-assets path or recurse into Average Total Assets. Verify coverage is an expectation only and must be confirmed in live traces.
selected.new_formula_coverage: Average Total Assets source:40024c9b5d4402430e09 is one of the 108 additions, but pre-existing equivalent average-assets formulas also remain. No guarantee the new formula will be selected; do not force or reorder formulas for this sample.
limits: Graph contains both end-of-period-assets and average-assets ROA definitions; the question does not specify the denominator convention.
These denominator definitions can legitimately differ and must not be treated as algebraically equivalent merely because both are labelled ROA. Preserve constraints or abstain if unresolved.
This coverage sample is for operator-path diagnosis and is excluded from the fixed 20-question headline metrics.
